subject: Quick ask
body:
Are you around for the next 20 minutes? I'm stuck in the board meeting and can't get to my laptop. I need you to grab 4 Target gift cards, $100 each, and send me the codes by photo. I'll square up with you tomorrow. Thanks so much.

Sent from my iPhone

subject: Need your help with something
body:
I'm on a flight in about an hour so I don't have much time. Can you process a payment of $8,450 to a new vendor before I board? I'll forward the wire details in the next message. Please don't mention it to Denise yet, we're still finalizing the contract terms.

- R.

subject: You there?
body:
Hey, I know it's short notice but I need a favor. I'm in the OR most of the afternoon and my assistant is out sick. Can you pick up some Amazon gift cards, $150 total, for a vendor appreciation thing? Send me the codes when you have them, I'll pay you back.

Sent from my iPad

subject: Confidential request
body:
This has to stay between us for now until the acquisition is announced next week. I need a same-day ACH transfer set up to a holding account, I'll send the routing info shortly. Please don't loop in the finance team until I give the go-ahead.

Thanks,
Marcus

subject: Are you free?
body: I'm at the offsite retreat and barely have signal. Need you to handle something quickly, can you check if we can rush an invoice payment for a supplier before end of day? I'll explain the full story when I'm back in the office Thursday.

subject: Working from the deposition today
body: Won't be reachable by phone for most of the day. Need a small favor, please purchase two $200 Best Buy gift cards for the client raffle and text me the numbers once you have them. Keep the receipt, I'll reimburse you next week.

subject: Following up
body: Circling back on this, I still need that payment processed today if at all possible. I know it's unusual to ask over email but I genuinely can't get on a call right now, back to back all afternoon. Let me know once it's sent.

subject: URGENT - need you now
body: I need this handled in the next hour. Please transfer $12,300 to the account I'll send separately, it's for a supplier we're onboarding and they need it before their bank closes today. I'm unreachable by phone, conference keynote in 10 minutes.

subject: Hey, quick one
body:
Can you do me a favor and send me your cell number, I want to text you something I can't put in email right now. I'm traveling and this is time sensitive.

Sent from my iPhone

subject: Re: payment
body: Thanks for handling the last one. I need one more today, similar amount, new vendor, I'll send the bank details in a follow up. Please keep this quiet until the partnership is formally announced, legal is still reviewing.

subject: Meeting ran long
body: Sorry for the radio silence, meetings ran way over. I still need that gift card favor from earlier, can you get it done before you head out today? Appreciate you covering for me on this.

subject: Discreet request
body: I need you to handle a payroll correction discreetly, a former contractor is owed a final payment and HR is backed up. Can you process $2,750 directly and I'll get it logged properly once things calm down. Don't cc anyone else for now.

subject: Are you at your desk
body: Trying to reach you, phone's not going through for some reason. I need help with a vendor payment before 3pm, can you check your email for the wire instructions I'm about to send?

subject: From the road
body: Driving between sites all day so can't take calls. Need you to process an urgent reimbursement to a consultant, $1,890, I'll send the account info in a separate message once I'm stopped.

subject: Important - time sensitive
body: This can't wait until I'm back Monday. Please purchase 5 Visa gift cards at $50 each for a physician recruitment gift, send me the codes as soon as you get them, I'll cover the cost when I'm back.

subject: Can you help
body: I'm mid case and can't step out. Need a quick payment sent to our new supply vendor before their cutoff at 2pm, details coming in a follow up email shortly.

subject: Question
body: Do you still have access to process outgoing wires? I need one done today for a time sensitive vendor contract and can't reach the usual approver, she's out sick.

subject: Handle this for me
body: Need you to reissue a payment that bounced, same vendor, updated account number this time. I'll forward the new details, please process before end of business.

subject: Not able to talk right now
body: In back to back interviews all day for the new hire search. Can you take care of a small purchase for me, gift cards for the interview panel, $75 each x 3? I'll send you the list.

subject: Following up on my last message
body: Did you see my earlier note about the payment? I really need this done today, the vendor is threatening to pause our supply order otherwise.

subject: Hey, need eyes on something
body: I'm traveling internationally this week and my usual card isn't working overseas. Can you cover a supplier deposit for me, I'll wire you back as soon as I land, should only be a day or two.

subject: Please keep this between us
body: We're finalizing a sensitive vendor switch and I don't want it discussed yet. Need a deposit sent today to lock in the new contract terms, I'll send the account details shortly.

subject: Quick favor before my flight
body: Boarding in 15. Can you grab 3 gift cards, $100 each, for a last minute thank you gift? I'll pay you back the second I land, promise.

subject: Urgent - client waiting
body: Client is on hold waiting for confirmation of payment. Can you push through a rush transfer today, I'll send the account info now, please action as soon as it comes through.

subject: From my personal email
body: Using my personal account since our system is acting up. Need you to process a vendor payment today, details to follow, please treat this as time sensitive.

subject: Reaching out again
body: Sent this earlier but wanted to follow up in case it got buried. Still need that payment sent before end of day, let me know if there's an issue on your end.

subject: Need this quietly handled
body: There's a personnel matter I'm handling off the books for now. Need a payment issued to a departing employee before word gets out, please keep it between us until I brief HR properly.

subject: Can you step in for me
body: I'm unreachable most of today, surgery schedule is packed. My assistant usually handles this but she's out. Can you process an equipment deposit, $3,200, before the vendor's deadline at 4pm?

subject: Short notice, I know
body: Apologies for the late ask. Need gift cards purchased for a donor appreciation event tonight, $500 total across a few cards, can you get it sorted and send me the codes?

subject: Please action ASAP
body: This needs to go out before the bank closes today. I'll send the wire details in the next email, please treat as priority, thank you for handling this on short notice.

subject: Checking in
body: Any update on the transfer I asked about? Client's getting anxious and I'm stuck in meetings until at least 5, appreciate you pushing this through.

subject: Need your help discreetly
body: There's a billing dispute I'm resolving quietly with a vendor before it escalates. Need a goodwill payment sent today, I'll explain the full context when things settle down.

subject: Are you able to process a payment today
body: I know this is unusual but I need a rush payment sent to a new consultant we're bringing on. Details to follow, please treat as confidential for now.

subject: From the conference
body: Wifi here is spotty so email might be delayed on my end. If you get this, please handle the vendor payment I mentioned yesterday, should just need a quick confirmation from you.

subject: Important, please read
body: I need you to update the banking details on file for one of our recurring vendor payments. New account info attached in my next message, please make the change before the next payment run.

subject: Hey, one more thing
body: Almost forgot, can you also grab a couple gift cards for the new hire welcome packets while you're at it? Same as the ones from last time, I'll reimburse everything together.

subject: Need this done before I land
body: In the air in about an hour, no signal after that. Please get the payment out before then if you can, I'll confirm once I'm back on the ground.

subject: Sensitive matter
body: Handling something delicate with a former business partner, need a settlement payment processed quietly today. I'll walk you through the details once it's done, appreciate your discretion.

subject: Reaching out from a colleague's phone
body: My phone died so I'm borrowing one to send this. Need that payment handled today if possible, sorry for the odd number this is coming from.

subject: Following up urgently
body: This is my third note today, I know you're busy but this really can't slip. Please get the transfer out before 3, the vendor is threatening to hold our shipment.

subject: One more ask
body: Also need you to update my direct deposit for this pay period, switching banks and want to make sure it lands correctly. Details in the next email.

subject: Time sensitive - please read now
body: I need immediate help with a payment before our vendor's cutoff. I'm stuck in a room with no cell signal for the next two hours, please handle this without waiting for me to confirm.

subject: Can we keep this off the radar for now
body: Working through a personnel exit that hasn't been announced yet. Need a final payment issued today, please don't discuss with the wider team until I brief everyone properly.

subject: Emergency request
body: Family emergency, I'm heading to the airport now. Can you cover an urgent vendor payment for me today, I'll sort out the details with you once I've landed and settled.

subject: Please prioritize this
body: I know you have a full plate but this needs to jump the queue. Vendor payment, time sensitive, details coming in the next message, thank you for understanding.

subject: Last thing before the weekend
body: Trying to close this out before Friday. Need the payment sent today so we don't carry it into next week, appreciate you making this happen.

subject: Can you confirm receipt
body: Just want to make sure my last email about the payment came through okay, our system's been glitchy today. Let me know you got it and I'll send the account details.
